title: CNMD - RoadTransportNetwork schema
description: A road transport network, aligned with FIWARE Smart Data Models and INSPIRE.

addressLocality.description: The locality, which must correspond to the municipality

addressRegion.description: The NUTS 2 region in which the locality is located

district.description: The administrative district in which the locality is located

type.description: Property. NGSI entity type. It must be RoadTransportNetwork.

accessibility.description: Property. Accessibility index of the network. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

beginLifespanVersion.description: Property. Date and time from which this network version is valid. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'.

boundingBox.description: GeoProperty. GeoJSON Polygon delimiting the area covered by the network.

concessionary.description: Relationship. Concessionaires of the road network.

connectivity.description: Property. Connectivity index of the network. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

connectedNetworks.description: Relationship. Adjacent or connected road networks.

crossBorderPoints.description: Property. Connection points to other administrative regions, including location, connection type and traffic volume. Model:'https://schema.org/StructuredValue'.

emergencyRoutes.description: Relationship. Routes designated for emergency evacuation.

endLifespanVersion.description: Property. Date and time until which this network version is valid. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'.

hasParts.description: Relationship. Road segments and nodes that constitute this network.

lastFullInspection.description: Property. Date and time of the last full network inspection. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'.

maintenanceAuthority.description: Property. Organization responsible for network maintenance, including its name, contact details and website. Model:'https://schema.org/StructuredValue'.

networkClassification.description: Property. Classification of the road network.

networkStatus.description: Property. Current overall state of the network, including its general condition, critical points and congestion level. Model:'https://schema.org/StructuredValue'.

networkType.description: Property. Type of road network according to the OpenStreetMap highway classification.

roadClass.description: Property. Distribution of road classes in the network, including length by class. Model:'https://schema.org/StructuredValue'.

totalLength.description: Property. Total length of the network. Units:'KMT'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

totalNodes.description: Property. Total number of nodes in the network. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

totalSegments.description: Property. Total number of segments in the network. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

trafficStatistics.description: Property. Aggregated traffic information, including average daily volume, peak-hour volume and congestion hours. Model:'https://schema.org/StructuredValue'.

version.description: Property. Version of the data model. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.
